handoff.goals: Connect the detected Supabase and Sentry sources to the PostHog data warehouse, or provide browser completion links.
handoff.did: Inspected PostHog-defined source requirements for Postgres (used for Supabase) and Sentry, checked whether relevant local environment variable keys exist without reading values, and requested each source's required credentials in one combined collection round. The supplied answers were blank, so no source credentials were submitted and no project code was modified. Published the finished user-facing warehouse report section.
handoff.forNextAgent: Both sources reached a decided browser-handoff outcome because credentials were not provided. No external data source was created. Use the report section unchanged in the final reporting step.
handoff.evidence: `external-data-sources-wizard` returned fields for Postgres and Sentry; `.env` key check found SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_DB_URL, DATABASE_URL, SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, and SENTRY_DSN missing; the single credential collection response contained blank answers for all requested fields. Browser links were published.
handoff.assumptions: Used the PostHog MCP active-environment application origin (https://eu.posthog.com) for browser links, rather than the supplied ingestion host, because warehouse source setup is a PostHog app page.
handoff.conflict: No credentials were provided, so Supabase and Sentry require browser setup.

handoff.goals: Install the JavaScript web PostHog SDK using the project's package manager, with a manifest fallback if the environment prevents resolution.
handoff.did: Detected npm, confirmed posthog-js was absent from package.json, attempted `npm add posthog-js`, and added the documented fallback dependency `posthog-js: ^1.407.2` to package.json after the command timed out. This declares the browser SDK for later client-side instrumentation and its analytics events.
handoff.forNextAgent: Import the browser SDK as `posthog-js`. The install command timed out after 120 seconds, so package-lock.json was not updated; run `npm add posthog-js` in a functioning network environment before relying on the lockfile or build dependency resolution. No server SDK was added because package.json indicates a Vite React client application only.
handoff.evidence: `npm add posthog-js` was run and timed out after 120 seconds with no package-manager output. package.json was then re-read and edited to add the fallback dependency.
handoff.assumptions: The timeout reflects an environment/registry limitation. No server-side event-sending code was established from the manifest, so posthog-node was not needed.
handoff.conflict: npm installation timed out, leaving package-lock.json unchanged; posthog-js is declared in package.json as the prescribed fallback.
